data.summary: Senior Business Analyst with 12 years of experience delivering business analysis, data analysis, and Agile transformation initiatives across Banking, Wealth Management, Capital Markets, and Enterprise Data Protection. Proven expertise in gathering and translating business requirements into functional solutions, facilitating stakeholder workshops, preparing BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and supporting end-to-end Agile/Scrum delivery. Hands-on experience analyzing transactional and customer datasets using SQL for data validation, reconciliation, KPI reporting, and business insights. Working knowledge of excel on data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, CSV processing, and analytical validation. Strong experience collaborating with product owners, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions, support UAT, improve data quality, and drive process optimization in fast-paced Agile environments.

raw_sections.summary:
Summary
Senior Business Analyst with 12 years of experience delivering business analysis, data analysis, and Agile transformation initiatives across Banking, Wealth Management, Capital Markets, and Enterprise Data Protection. Proven expertise in gathering and translating business requirements into functional solutions, facilitating stakeholder workshops, preparing BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and supporting end-to-end Agile/Scrum delivery. Hands-on experience analyzing transactional and customer datasets using SQL for data validation, reconciliation, KPI reporting, and business insights. Working knowledge of excel on data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, CSV processing, and analytical validation. Strong experience collaborating with product owners, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions, support UAT, improve data quality, and drive process optimization in fast-paced Agile environments.
raw_sections.experience:
Experience
Accenture Pvt Ltd Business Analyst
09/2019 - Present
Gathered, unified, and rigorously validated data from diverse sources, loading source data into tables for further analysis and generating queries to maintain
high standards of accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Created BRD's and FRD's also developed process mapping flow diagrams and BPNM. • Reduced manual validation effort by developing reusable SQL validation scripts. • Consolidated and validated data from diverse sources, loading it into structured tables and generating queries to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity. • Validating the source and target tables and perform data cleansing and creating dashboards in pivots in advance excel. • Worked as Data analyst and performed analytical data validation using joins, aggregations, GROUP BY, CASE statements, window functions, CTE and ranking logic.
Designed reports, dashboards, and pivot-based summaries to support analytics and data-driven decision-making. • Analyzed data to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights; delivered ad-hoc analysis as needed. • Gathered and documented requirements for securing sensitive data (in transit and at rest), ensuring alignment with data protection, privacy, and GIS standards. • Defined specs and supported security controls: encryption, authentication, integrity validation. • Contributed to storage-security enhancements to address vulnerabilities and strengthen compliance. • Collaborated with architects, developers, and QA to resolve UAT defects, validate fixes, and confirm deployment readiness. • Communicated progress to stakeholders through structured reports, UAT sign-offs, and sprint reviews. 02/2018 - 09/2019
Designed reports, dashboards, and pivot-based summaries to support analytics and data-driven decision-making. • Analyzed data to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights; delivered ad-hoc analysis as needed. • Gathered and documented requirements for securing sensitive data (in transit and at rest), ensuring alignment with data protection, privacy, and GIS standards. • Defined specs and supported security controls: encryption, authentication, integrity validation. • Contributed to storage-security enhancements to address vulnerabilities and strengthen compliance. • Collaborated with architects, developers, and QA to resolve UAT defects, validate fixes, and confirm deployment readiness. • Communicated progress to stakeholders through structured reports, UAT sign-offs, and sprint reviews. 02/2018 - 09/2019
Translated UK wealth management needs into clear specifications, user stories, and process flows through analysis of business requirements and data. • Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, including test case preparation, execution support, and business sign-off, ensuring system compatibility. • Provided production support, performing root-cause analysis and coordinating with technology teams for timely incident resolution and system stability. • Developed comprehensive domain knowledge and continuous learning in UK wealth management processes such as client onboarding, KYC/AML, and investment advisory workflows.
Worked collaboratively with financial advisors and compliance teams to gather and validate business requirements, prioritizing essential enhancements. • Engaged with clients and advisory teams to support iterative enhancements to investment and digital platforms by clarifying requirements and gathering feedback.
Produced detailed documentation including BRDs, functional specifications, UAT artifacts, and supported release activities for seamless system
implementation.
Syntel International Pvt. Ltd Consultant
03/2014 - 02/2018
Interpreted FCA regulatory requirements and translated them into clear, actionable system specifications. • Ensured accurate documentation, client validation, and formal approval of business requirements. • Decomposed high-level requirements into detailed user stories and assigned work packages to development teams. • Conducted end-to-end requirement lifecycle from analysis through delivery and implementation. • Acted as the key liaison between client, developers, and QA teams to ensure alignment and clarity. • Coordinated and assisted integration testing to validate compliant system functionality. • Maintained governance, traceability, and audit-ready documentation throughout the project lifecycle. • Ensured successful regulatory-compliant releases by overseeing requirement fulfilment and risk mitigation.
